summary: Frontend-only feature pass (Current Effective Terms ledger + Amendment Diff + simplified mobile FindingCard + lapsed neutral rendering). Backend unchanged in this feature and re-verified via curl (login 200, /contracts/{id} 200, /findings 200, /superseded-history 200). E2E UI verified end-to-end on the public preview URL against the pre-seeded contract 6a8c968f38ffe86939d74f51 for the ledger+amendment-diff scenario AND against a synthesised lapsed-deadline contract for the neutral-lapsed rendering. All 11 acceptance criteria pass on both desktop (1440x1000) and mobile (390x844) viewports.

per_acceptance.ledger_placement_and_rows: PASS — [data-testid=current-effective-terms] visible on desktop and mobile between contract identity header and 'What matters'. Rows 0-6 rendered in order: Current term ends (Dec 31, 2026), Renewal starts (Jan 1, 2027), Non-renewal notice period (30 days), Notice anchor (Term end), Current deadline (Dec 1, 2026), Notice method (certified mail), Notice recipient (General Counsel of the receiving party). Annual value row present ('Not provided').
per_acceptance.row_source_filenames: PASS — Rows show governing-source filenames only where a matching finding.sources entry with the correct purpose exists: primary.pdf on 0,1,5,6; amendment.pdf on 2,3,4 (the fields that actually changed via the amendment). No invented labels.
per_acceptance.pending_amendment_line: PASS — [data-testid=cet-pending-amendment-note] visible with exact text 'Latest amendment changes are awaiting your review.' since the active renewal_notice finding is state=unconfirmed AND has a preserved superseded predecessor. Also verified on mobile.
per_acceptance.amendment_diff_toggle_and_rows: PASS — 'Review amendment changes' disclosure renders on desktop AND mobile. Click reveals exactly the 2 changed fields: 'Notice period 10 days -> 30 days' and 'Deadline December 21, 2026 -> December 1, 2026'. Unchanged fields (effective date, renewal type/period, notice method/recipient, notice anchor, term end/renewal start) correctly OMITTED.
per_acceptance.amendment_evidence_panel: PASS — 'Show the evidence' toggles a two-column paper-surface panel with Original clause quote (primary.pdf · Primary agreement · p.1) and Amendment clause quote (amendment.pdf · Amendment · p.1). Both quotes match the source contract text and are labeled with filename + doc role + location.
per_acceptance.superseded_finding_hidden_from_list: PASS — Only one active FindingCard renders on ContractDetail; the superseded 10-day predecessor is not exposed as a top-level card. It surfaces only via the amendment-diff disclosure + evidence panel.
per_acceptance.mobile_findingcard_universal_deadline_st: PASS — Mobile card shows 'DEC 1 · 99 days remaining' (universal deadline-state line). Old 'Term ends X - N days = Y' math sentence is absent.
per_acceptance.mobile_confirm_correct_dismiss_present: PASS — On the unconfirmed amendment-diff mobile card, Confirm deadline + Correct + Dismiss buttons are all present and clickable (previous session had only Confirm+Prepare-notice on mobile).
per_acceptance.lapsed_deadline_neutral: PASS — Synthesised a lapsed renewal_notice (effective_action_deadline 2024-12-02, days_remaining -365, state=confirmed/validated). Rendered on BOTH desktop and mobile: shows '630 days past deadline' universal deadline-state line + 'Non-renewal window elapsed' disclaimer, does NOT render a 'Prepare notice' button, does NOT render the DEADLINE REMINDERS / Set reminder RemindersBlock, and no elements carry stamp-urgent color classes (audited for [class*=urgent] / [class*=cc-stamp] — zero matches on either viewport).
per_acceptance.clause_drawer_dedup: Not exercised directly this iteration — inspected buildAmendmentDiff + FindingCard grouped-sources dedup logic (~line 222 of FindingCard) statically; dedup keys on purpose+quote+location. Recommend main agent smoke on the standard Amendment Diff contract's 'Show the contract language' drawer once the amendment finding is confirmed.
per_acceptance.regression_findings_and_analyze_flow: PASS (indirect) — /findings + /analyze + /superseded-history endpoints all returned 200 for the seeded contract; the finding is served with resolved document_metadata that the new client-side code depends on.

critical_code_review_comments: CurrentEffectiveTerms.longDate parses ISO by splitting on '-' and constructing new Date(y, m-1, d) — safe for the 'YYYY-MM-DD' format the backend emits today, but will silently misrender if a full ISO timestamp with a T-suffix ever leaks into these fields. Consider a stricter guard or a shared date util.

AmendmentDiff.buildAmendmentDiff treats before==null && after==null as 'no row' via a separate check AFTER the equality check — the equality check `before === after` will already skip when both are null; the second guard is dead code (harmless).

AmendmentDiff.pickEvidencePair uses ONLY the first changed row that has a validated before AND after source quote. For the seeded 2-field diff both changed fields share purpose 'notice_period' so this is fine, but for multi-purpose diffs the UI shows a single evidence pair that may not correspond visually to the first listed row. Consider labelling which field the evidence supports (e.g. 'Evidence for: Notice period') or rendering per-row evidence.

ContractDetail.load(): superseded-history 404/error is silently swallowed (`.catch(() => {})`). If the endpoint fails the user still sees the ledger without the pending-amendment note or diff — no user-visible error. Consider surfacing a subtle inline warning consistent with the /findings error handling comment from iteration 10.

CurrentEffectiveTerms hardcodes the row list for renewal_notice only (component name is generic-sounding). If Ledger extends to other finding types in future, the component signature will need a `type` prop; current implementation is fine because ContractDetail only mounts it for `renewalFinding`.

FindingCard renders desktop (`hidden md:block`) and mobile (`md:hidden`) as siblings under one component — this means every data-testid inside FindingCard exists twice in the DOM (one hidden). Pre-existing architecture, but any future automated test authors must use `:visible` filtering (already documented in the review request).
seed_data_creation: Inserted a synthesised lapsed renewal_notice contract+finding directly via pymongo (ObjectId _ids + ISO-string created_at/updated_at — the model requires string). Cleaned up on test exit. Pre-existing Amendment Diff test contract 6a8c968f38ffe86939d74f51 was used read-only (no writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The lapsed-scenario seed pattern in this iteration writes _id as an ObjectId and stores created_at/updated_at as ISO strings (NOT datetime objects — Finding.from_mongo Pydantic model rejects datetime). Reuse this shape if you need to fabricate contracts/findings for edge tests. Contract 6a8c968f38ffe86939d74f51 remains the canonical amendment-diff fixture.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects surfaced this iteration.
